findings.statement: Process-text bullet for blocking UNKNOWN omits what warrant ci 0.8 checks on the DECISION ref (ADR-0040 p.3): URL form #issuecomment-/#pullrequestreview- (not #discussion_r), author in roles.maintainer, comment text contains the UNK id, comment in the spec-PR; also that unknown add/resolve works only in PROPOSED/SPECIFIED and the agent must not resolve without that comment. An agent following the text can cite a line comment and get a red impl-PR.
findings.recommendation: List these ref conditions and the PROPOSED/SPECIFIED limit in the UNKNOWN bullet; add them to the 2.1 check.

findings.statement: Waiver-path bullet is incomplete vs ADR-0024 p.4 and ADR-0040 p.4/p.8: spec edit only after a maintainer decision (not agent initiative), proposal.md is outside implement write_scope, waiver reason must cite the I-N line, agent creates PROPOSED waiver, maintainer activates with warrant waive --activate <WAV> --by and who commits the activated waiver and before which step (VERIFYING/merge) is not said.
findings.recommendation: Spell out trigger (maintainer decision), allowed files (design.md, specs/**), reason->I-N, activation command, actor and ordering.

findings.statement: D-1 assumes CLI 0.8 warrant ci accepts the impl-PR whose base lock is kernel 0.7/core-sdd 0.3.3 and whose APPROVED/IMPLEMENTING transitions were written by CLI 0.7 (effective policy of pack 0.3.3) while VERIFYING is written under 0.3.4 (ADR-0038 p.1: pack hash differs -> law change). Risks only say stop on refusal: no path to finish the Change, and nothing verifies the assumption before approval.
findings.recommendation: Add a task to rehearse D-1 on a scratch branch (CLI 0.8 verify/ci against base with 0.7 lock) before impl-PR, and name the fallback if it fails.

findings.statement: Current process.json enumerates record writers as (init change, classify, transition, run, waive, ci fetch, archive); proposal does not add unknown to this list, so the edited text contradicts its own new UNKNOWN bullet.
findings.recommendation: Add unknown to the list of edits of process.json.

findings.statement: D-3 says effective policy 'may' put human-approval on VERIFYING->MERGED for this Change; record risk is HIGH, so overlay risk-high puts it for certain. Migration Plan step 3 (MERGED) omits --by for this Change.
findings.recommendation: State the gate is present (risk-high) and write MERGED --by <maintainer> in step 3.

findings.statement: D-1 needs CLI 0.7 and 0.8 side by side, while Impact tells to install 0.8 globally; how 0.7 is invoked for the first commit is not said.
findings.recommendation: Name the invocation of each CLI in D-1 (e.g. node <SRA-v0.7.0>/dist/bin/warrant.js vs global 0.8).

findings.statement: Rollback 'revert impl-PR' (and reversibility EASY) ignores that a PR touching .github/workflows/** or .warrant/** without a factory-change Change is rejected by warrant ci (ADR-0038 p.3); rollback is itself a pin-Change.
findings.recommendation: Describe rollback as a factory-change Change (or revert within the same Change before merge).

findings.statement: With skip_specs the proposal is the contract, but acceptance of the process text (task 2.1) only checks that AGENTS.md names warrant unknown and warrant waive; removal of unconditional --by at MERGED and the ref conditions are unchecked.
findings.recommendation: Extend the 2.1 check: no unconditional --by at MERGED, UNKNOWN ref conditions, waiver activation actor.

findings.statement: ADR-0040 p.5 removes --by at MERGED from process text unconditionally; proposal keeps it conditional. Justified by BL-74 (risk HIGH overlay), cited only in design D-3.
findings.recommendation: Cite BL-74 in the proposal bullet.

findings.statement: skip_specs is justified: no library behavior changes, the claims are config values checked by validate/sync --check and CI; a process capability would need areas.json, unwritable in spec-PR.

unknowns.question: Does CLI 0.8 warrant ci/verify accept transitions APPROVED/IMPLEMENTING written by CLI 0.7 under pack 0.3.3 in the same impl-PR?

assumptions.statement: required-artifacts-present counts skip_specs as skipped for specs (D-2), not verified in code.
No gate requires a Run implement record for the policy-path edits made outside guard (ADR-0041).
